_comment: Non-copyrighted preservation manifest and bounded findings for the six-row Phase-4 traversal-plant batch; frame boundaries are not exact writer evidence.
bounded_conclusions: All six relevant capsules reconstruct under the exact pinned reader without a record-count or domain-hash error.
The six movies are current centrally hash-pinned pristine-media fixtures with declared start states and matching capsule media controls.
The batch retains four mushroom bounce boundaries, two propeller lift ramps, one dandelion launch boundary, one cannon launch, four green lifecycles and four purple equip transitions.
The B04 title does not override the retained state: no later discrete dandelion-sized impulse follows its cannon launch.
Frame-boundary correlation and passive block starts do not attribute exact CPU writers, collision geometry, DMA/GPU/SPU producers, causal controls, or between-frame behavior.

B01_mushroom_trampoline.bounded_observation: Four frame-boundary transitions to -3328 correlate with four distinct nearby type-5 slots and passive mushroom-handler block starts. The capsule does not prove a combo law, fifth-bounce bonus, or exact writer.

B02_propeller_plant.bounded_observation: Two player lift ramps reach and hold -3072. A seed follows a vertical trajectory overlapping the second ramp after an earlier exact player/seed position-attachment interval. The attachment ends before that lift, so the capsule does not prove propeller-to-seed causality.

B03_dandelion_glide.bounded_observation: One frame-boundary transition to -4096 is retained. Later propeller and dandelion handler overlap ends in a grounded state, but passive block starts do not establish a glide attachment, updraft, sink law, or writer.

B04_cannon_plant.bounded_observation: The retained seated interval is followed by one cannon-sized launch. A type-8 handler coexists, but no later discrete transition to -4096 is retained; the movie name is not proof of a successful combo.

B05_green_leaf_platforms.bounded_observation: The fixture retains one complete type-4, type-10, type-9 and type-1 lifecycle with distinct phase timing. The shared collision tail executes, but frame boundaries do not bind a specific leaf plane or climb primitive.

B10_purple_berry_plants.bounded_observation: Four complete type-6 lifecycles correlate with one grant-handler start and one equipped-byte transition each, in order 0,1,2,4,3. Exact pickup collision and reset behavior remain outside frame-boundary attribution.
